meaning: Local static and headless validation only. Source normalizes CRLF; reports, saves and build bytes are exact. Tests run locally; Pages builds/deploys only.

regression.note: Retain the initial full-run failures and skipped cases. Final coverage requires every test in each latest complete file result to pass; no assertion or test timeout was weakened.

campaign.scope: Fresh generated desert. State changes only through public player commands, ordinary ticks and exact save/load. No terrain, supplies, skills, animal species, ownership, hunger, age, growth, fullness, RNG, task or clock injection. Read-only terrain/path inspection selects ordinary buildable sites. Proves one natural resource chain and interruption/reload boundaries, not long-term balance or native visual equivalence.

build.typecheck: tsc --noEmit passed as part of npm run build and after test-schema expectation updates

limits: No native or browser gameplay or visual acceptance.
Controlled edge-case fixtures are distinct from the generated-world campaign and authentic historical save.
Single-seed natural campaign is not long-term economy or difficulty calibration.
Full animal health, training, wool, eggs and native global stat modifiers remain incomplete.
